submission.natural_language_explanation: L18/N2794+ fires retrospectively on the current token when it continues an already-open word or fixed phrase: mid-word fragments (hab, oxic, ochond, ebra, re, h) and the predictable second half of common collocations (but after asked-comma, at after contain, the after on/to, pleaded after defendant, fraud after because-of, commas in lists, the first digit of a round number after at), with strength scaling from ~0.25 for ordinary continuations to 1.35 for highly fused subwords; the same word outside a continuation slot fires far less (the: 0.25 after on vs 0.03 after red; but: 0.50 mid-sentence vs 0.14 sentence-initial). It is retrospective, not lookahead: 45% of input attribution is on the peak token itself with mean distance 1.9 tokens, downstream edits leave peaks unchanged, the Jacobian lens shows no coherent promoted set (kurtosis 3.3), and the negative pole fires instead on onsets of new words (instruments, sunrise, function, river).
